column1: # Known faults of STEGO's own tree against its code standard (ST-STD-CODE), at the commit that holds this file.
# The tooling record ST-ASR-TOOL03 names this file. TestOwnTree in code_standard_test.go reads it from the
# commit under test, not from the working tree.
# A rule test fails when the tree has a fault that this list does not hold, and when this list holds a fault
# that the tree does not have. Thus the list can only get shorter: when you fix a fault, remove its line in
# the same change. Do not add a line for a new fault; fix the fault.
# One fault per line: the rule, the file or package, and the reason, with a tab between them.
